Avoid calibration in extreme rain or snow conditions. There should be a certain number of stationary metal objects on both sides of the road, such as lamp posts, road guardrails, and road signs. When conditions permit, it is recommended to choose a closed road with metal railings. The road surface should be flat, without excessive potholes or bumps, and should not have snow, ice, mud, or other road conditions that could easily cause tire slippage. It is recommended to drive at a speed of 10-60 km/h, keep the vehicle moving in a straight line, avoid sudden acceleration and deceleration, ensure the radar is installed correctly, and that the installation position is normal. — Midd Front  Millimeter-wave radar calibration
